value.rationale: For the marginal quadratic arithmetic Ising model, previously known alpha_f and logarithmic MFIS dimension do not specify the actual population distribution on the flat direction or the full finite-graph state. The finding determines the sharp natural partition coefficient and a four-factor independent limit (logarithmic total scale, Gamma interaction energy, two Dirichlet internal shares) for every balanced complete-bipartite size. It supplies precise testable observables and a finite-volume benchmark, without misrepresenting the already-known leading exponent or proving thermodynamic phase stability.
